title: Product
description: One Shopify product bought on Mercado Libre. File: local/stores/<slug>/products/<key>.json

key.description: File name and the name used in commands.

status.description: A paused product is skipped by every run.

product_id.description: Numeric id; orders are matched on it, never on SKU.

variants.description: Every variant that may be sold. An order with a variant missing here goes to manual review.

units_per_item.description: Units to buy for one of this variant; 2 for a pack of two.

listings.description: Mercado Libre listings in the order they are tried: the first is the main one, the rest are fallbacks.

seller.description: Seller name that must appear on the page; catalogue pages can switch seller.

variation.description: Attribute that must be selected, e.g. Color / Marrón; null when the listing has none.

verified.description: What a no-payment checkout showed when the listing was approved.

identical_evidence.description: Why this is the same product as the store's: photos, measures, materials.

limits.description: A purchase may cost at most units x max_unit_price + max_shipping.

mode.description: first_purchase_pending: the first purchase waits for the user. auto: pay without asking. each_purchase: every purchase waits.

first_order.description: Order whose purchase the user approved first.

decided_at.description: When the user chose auto or each_purchase.
